## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +0.68%) with VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -12.50% | 1M: -9.85%) and HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +0.79%) providing independent confirmation of risk appetite.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX BELOW TREND (1W: -12.50% | 1M: -9.85%) ↓ falling. Stocks vs Bonds RISK-ON: SPY/TLT ↑ rising (proxy SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +0.68%); TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.51% | 1M: -1.40%)). Credit mixed: HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +0.79%) while credit spread level (0.7332) remains elevated.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar weakening: UUP in CORRECTION (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +0.11%) ↓ falling and below trend readings. Yield tone neutral-to-looser with TLT RECOVERY (1W: +0.51% | 1M: -1.40%) and a flat-to-narrowing yield curve (↓ falling, BELOW TREND).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Financials leading: XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +5.88%) and Tech strong: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +1.78%); Semis outperformance notable: SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.84% | 1M: +11.82%). Energy lagging: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.78% | 1M: +3.79%) — style: Growth/Momentum leading.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms with SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.77% | 1M: +0.68%) while EMs showing catch-up: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +2.73%). China mixed: FXI RECOVERY (1W: +2.05% | 1M: -0.82%) while China tech remains below broader leadership.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation down but active: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +3.02%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +3.58%) show risk-on breadth into cyclicals and crypto ETFs. ARKK in RECOVERY (1W: +0.76% | 1M: -5.45%) suggests selective speculative redeployment rather than a broad retail surge.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Energy-linked commodities mixed: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +19.93%) while CPER in RECOVERY (1W: +2.53% | 1M: -2.41%). Gold under pressure: GLD RECOVERY (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -8.36%) as equities lead.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing short-term pullback inside a longer upcycle: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.78% | 1M: +3.79%). Natural gas weak: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -11.33%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Broad equity participation with SPY, XLK and XLF all ABOVE TREND (SPY 1W: +3.77% | 1M: +0.68%; XLK 1W: +5.31% | 1M: +1.78%; XLF 1W: +5.31% | 1M: +5.88%). DIVERGENCE: Commodities and gold show 1W/1M mismatches (GLD RECOVERY vs 1M weakness), but divergence severity is MINOR.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor sectors showing momentum (SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.84% | 1M: +11.82%), XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +1.78%), XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +5.88%)) and EM exposure (EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +2.73%)). Reduce exposure to Energy (XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.78% | 1M: +3.79%)) and watch gold (GLD RECOVERY (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -8.36%)); bonds neutral (TLT RECOVERY).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.84% | 1M: +11.82%), XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +5.88%), XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +1.78%). BEARISH: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.78% | 1M: +3.79%), UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -11.33%), GLD RECOVERY (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -8.36%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +19.93%) and CPER RECOVERY (1W: +2.53% | 1M: -2.41%). BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -4.73% | 1M: -11.33%) and GLD RECOVERY (1W: +0.02% | 1M: -8.36%) on equity-led flows.

**13. Key Levels?**
VIX 30.39 (current fear barometer; VXX/ST trend confirming complacency removal), SPY/TLT 7.84 (↑ rising, risk-on signal), Credit spread 0.7332 (watch for wobble), Tech vs Financials ratio 2.7678 (pivot level for style rotation).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive.  
Semiconductors and Tech (SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.84% | 1M: +11.82%); XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +1.78%)) together with Financials (XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +5.88%)) are showing strength.  
Key risk: watch credit/commodities divergences—HYG/LQD mixed (HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +0.79%); LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.76% | 1M: -0.11%)) and Energy in CORRECTION (XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.78% | 1M: +3.79%)).
